desc: Prove the operation swaps gaps d_i and d_{i+2} while leaving d_{i+1} unchanged (reverse (d_i,d_{i+1},d_{i+2}) -> (d_{i+2},d_{i+1},d_i)).
Derive the parity invariant: odd-index gaps permute arbitrarily among odd positions, even-index gaps among even positions.
Express the coordinate sum as X_1*N + Σ_{j=1}^{N-1} (N-j)*d_j.
Optimality via rearrangement: weights (N-j) are decreasing, so assign sorted ascending gaps to increasing index within each parity class.
Implement O(N log N) solution with integer arithmetic; PASSED both public samples.
Edge-case sanity: N=4, N up to 2e5, large coordinate magnitudes all handled by the same formula and Python big ints.
